title: Sugar Industry Code of Conduct
summary: From 5 April 2017 a mandatory code governs supply contracts between sugar mills and cane growers, including growers' choice of sugar marketer.

instruments.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Code - Sugar) Regulations 2017

direction_rationale: The code strengthens growers' bargaining position against mills but limits mills' control over marketing.
comparison: Other agricultural supply chains; Queensland and northern NSW only
